This update was also given the name '''Consumables Update''', as this update added [[Consumables]]. This update encompassed eleven updates, the main v1.21.0 update (released 10 May 2024) and ten minor updates, v1.21.1 (10 May 2024), v1.21.2 (11 May 2024), v1.21.3 (11 May 2024), v1.21.4 (11 May 2024), v1.21.5 (11 May 2024), v1.21.6 (14 May 2024), v1.21.7 (14 May 2024), v1.21.8 (14 May 2024), v1.21.9 (16 May 2024) and v1.21.9a (16 May 2024). ==Additions== ===Towers=== :In '''v1.21.9''' :Two units were added as part of the [[Commander]] rework. *[[Gunner APC]] *[[Missile APC]] ===Consumable Crates=== *[[Low Grade Crate]] *[[Mid Grade Crate]] *[[High Grade Crate]] ===Consumables=== *[[Grenade]] *[[Flash Bang]] *[[Barricade]] *[[Supply Drop]] *[[AirStrike]] *[[Molotov]] *[[UAV]] *[[Napalm Strike]] *[[Damage Flag]] *[[Range Flag]] *[[Cooldown Flag]] *[[Blizzard Bomb]] *[[Nuke]] ===Miscellanous=== *[[VIP+]] *[[VIP+ Boost]] *Tower Pets **Only accessible through [[VIP+]] *{{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Tickets}} *[[Flying Detection Buff]] *New [[Codes|Code]]: IMCONSUMING **Gives one [[Mid Grade Crate]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *Updated tower hotbar UI during matches. **{{Money|Cash}} counter now quickly goes up when cash is gained or lost instead of going up instantly. **Tower icons leave a shadow behind them. **Empty slots now have different appearance. **Added [[Consumables]] swap button to the left. **Added [[Time Scale]] button to the left. **Updated tower stat appearance upon hover. **Slots now enlarge upon hover. *[[Boss]] enemies now are immune to [[Nuke]]'s fallout damage. *Updated the [[Cowboy]]'s inventory description. *[[Field Medic]]'s shield no longer deals damage to enemies equal to the unit's max health upon collision and does not protect it from damage when colliding with enemies, now it only protects units from enemy abilities. *[[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] ability damage to base health increased from 80 to 160. *Improved UI animations. *Improved game optimization. *Weekly quests now can give [[Low Grade Crate]]s, [[Mid Grade Crate|Mid Grade Crates]] and [[High Grade Crate]]s. *Chance to get something from a crate now includes decimals, up to two decimal places. *Changed [[Crook Boss]]'s goons names. **[[Pistol Goon]] renamed from ''Goon1'' to ''Pistol Goon''. **[[Tommy Goon 1|Tommy Goon]] renamed from ''Goon2'' to ''Pistol Goon''. ***As it does not wield a pistol, this name is a bug. It is referred to as ''Tommy Goon'' on the wiki instead. **[[Tommy Goon 2|Body Guard]] renamed from ''Goon3'' to ''Body Guard''. *Updated [[War Machine]] sound effects. *[[Boss]] health bars no longer display decimal health. *"''View Skins''" button is now called "''View Contents''". *Fixed icons covering up chance to unlock the item from a crate. *Fixed [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] having no animations in the third dialogue for [[Intermediate Mode|Intermediate]] mode's Wave 16. :In '''v1.21.1''': *Version number changed from '''v1.21.0''' to '''v1.21.1'''. :In '''v1.21.2''': *Fixed [[Badlands II]] and [[Polluted Wasteland II]] not working correctly. :In '''v1.21.3''': *Fixed the [[Quest]] UI not appearing. :In '''v1.21.4''': *The [[Time Scale]] button now appears even without the player having {{TimeScaleTicket|Time Scale Tickets}}. :In '''v1.21.5''': *Fixed lead detection not working for multiple towers. *Fixed [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] not appearing on the final wave of [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]]. *Fixed [[Molotov]] not playing sounds when equipped. :In '''v1.21.6''' *Tower pets are now displayed for all players. **One for normal players. **Three for VIP players. **[[VIP+]] player still display their full loadout. *Updated [[VIP+ Boost]] description. *Fixed [[Pursuit]] not stopping moving while attacking enemies. *Fixed the total damage statistic and damage quests not tracking for multiple towers. *Fixed [[VIP+]] boosted crate odds not working. *Fixed the {{Color|Premium|XR500}} [[Turret]] skin animations and sounds. *Fixed being able to use consumables in the [[Tutorial]]. *Fixed new players not having the fifth slot unlocked in the [[Tutorial]]. :In '''v1.21.7''': *Fixed culling sorting in the incorrect order. :In '''v1.21.8''': *Version number changed from ''v1.21.7'' to ''v1.21.8''. :In '''v1.21.9''': *[[Commander]]'s all skins except {{Color|Phantom|Phantom}} Level 0-4 appearance changed. *Updated [[Commander]]'s regular voice lines. *Added new voice lines for the {{Color|Deluxe|Neko}} and {{Color|Spooky|Ghost}} skins. *[[Commander]] reworked. **Placement limit of 3 '''Commanders''' per player added. **'''Commander''' now attacks enemies when any ability is activated, not just the ''Call to Arms'' ability. ***Attack time stacks if multiple ability are used in a short period of time. **New ''Call to Arms'' ability effects. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|650}} to {{Money|850}}. ****Range decreased from 12 to 9. ****Damage decreased from 4 to 0. ****Firerate decreased from 0.525 to 0. ****Hidden detection added. ****Flying detection added. ****[[Firerate Buff]] increased from 10% to 12.5%. ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost decreased from {{Money|850}} to {{Money|300}}. ****Range decreased from +2 to +0. ****[[Firerate Buff]] changed from 10% > 15% to 12.5% > 15%. ***'''Level 2''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|1,800}} to {{Money|2,500}}. ****Lead detection added. ****Range increased from +0 to +2. ****Damage increased from +0 to +10. ****Firerate changed from 0.525 to {{Tooltip|0 > 0.625|+0.625}}. ****''Call to Arms''' ability buff reduced from 30% to 15%. ***'''Level 3''' ****Range decreased from +2 to +1.5. ****Damage increased from +2 to +5. ****[[Firerate Buff]] decreased from 15% > 20% to 15% > 17.5%. ****''Call to Arms''' ability buff changed from 30% to 15% > 22.5%. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|9,000}} to {{Money|15,000}}. ****Range decreased from +4 to +1.5. ****Damage increased from +4 to +10. ****[[Firerate Buff]] decreased from 20% > 25% to 17.5% > 20%. ****''Call to Arms''' ability buff changed from 30% to 22.5% > 30%. ****''Support Caravan'' ability added. ****Name changed from ''World Leader'' to ''Strength in Numbers''. *Updated [[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] narrator's animated appearance. *Fixed firerate, range and [[Damage Buff]] indicators being sunken into the gronud. *Fixed {{Color|EndOfSummer|Lifeguard}} skin chair being buried in the ground. :In '''v1.21.9a''': *Fixed {{Color|ContentCreator|Eggrypted}}, {{Color|Other|Umbra}} and {{Color|Phantom|Phantom}} not having models. *Fixed {{Color|ContentCreator|Eggrypted}}, {{Color|Other|Umbra}} and {{Color|Phantom|Phantom}} not being placeable. *Fixed {{Color|ViolentNight|Holiday}} skin using incorrect animations.
